_about: W2-BREED config (owner request 2026-10-18; durango-prompts 02 and 09). Times are real seconds and timestamp-based (unix), so they survive save/load and offline time. Values not fixed by the owner are ASSUMPTIONs listed in docs/orchestration/reports/claude-mmo-w2-breed.md; tune them here.

bonded._about: Durango 09: 3 bonded slots + bonded_cap_bonus of each Animal Handling node (trees.json survival) the survivor bought. Caged/unbonded animals never count.

capture._about: Durango 09: eligible when stunned/collapsed at ANY HP, or HP under health_gate. Chance uses actual HP, level and capture ability (net tier above the species tier).
capture.hint_text: Stun the dinosaur to capture it safely

inheritance._about: Each stat IV comes from one parent: the higher one with this chance. Level gains and EVs are never inherited.

mutation._about: Per stat roll; a mutation adds iv_steps beyond the inherited parent's IV, capped at iv_cap. Lineage counters (maternal/paternal) at or past soft_cap multiply that side's chance by soft_cap_mult.

climate_temp_c._about: ASSUMPTION: climates.json has no temperatures yet (W2-SURVIVAL adds them); nests read the island climate through this table.

growth._about: baby -> juvenile -> adolescent -> adult. Stats scale from baby_stat_frac to 1 with maturity, times (1 + imprint_bonus * imprint). Unfed babies grow at neglect_rate; nothing ever kills them.

species._about: Per-species overrides: birth egg|gestation, incubation_s, gestation_s, egg_temp_c [min, max].
